_fixture: Known-good cohort for the Friday demo: residents' approved snapshots and manually reviewed connections, in the v1.1 contract. Arjun has not approved or shared, so he must not appear in the graph.

snapshots.name: Meera
snapshots.intent: Finish thirty interviews on how farming families borrow money, and turn them into a public report.
snapshots.problem: Small farmers borrow from informal lenders at steep rates, and banks never see how families actually decide.
snapshots.current_frontier: How do I get families to talk honestly about debt in a single visit?

positive.name: Empathy
positive.evidence: You save and share long stories about the people behind a statistic.

positive.name: Rigour
positive.evidence: You question sources and come back to correct earlier notes.

positive.name: Patience
positive.evidence: You follow topics over months rather than days.

positive.name: Curiosity
positive.evidence: You ask follow-up questions in most of your threads.

persona.summary: A researcher who earns trust slowly and turns long conversations into clear, fair writing.
persona.explanation: Empathy and rigour show up together: you return to the same families and check what you heard before you write it.

snapshots.name: Kabir
snapshots.intent: Get three working sensor prototypes into village water tanks and log a month of readings.
snapshots.problem: Village tanks run dry without warning, and the people who manage them have no cheap way to see the level.
snapshots.current_frontier: Can a sensor survive monsoon humidity and still cost under five hundred rupees?

positive.name: Making
positive.evidence: You watch and save build videos, then ask how to adapt them.

positive.name: Persistence
positive.evidence: You return to the same hardware problem across weeks.

positive.name: Practicality
positive.evidence: Your questions are about cost and what survives outdoors.

positive.name: Curiosity
positive.evidence: You browse adjacent fields like water policy now and then.

persona.summary: A builder who learns by soldering first and reading later, and keeps going until the thing works in the field.
persona.explanation: Making and persistence lead: most of what you watch and ask about is how to fix a specific broken part.

snapshots.name: Ananya
snapshots.intent: Draft four chapters of a book about the old markets of Pune.
snapshots.problem: The people who run Pune's old markets are disappearing as the markets modernise, and nobody is recording their stories.
snapshots.current_frontier: How do I shape the book so it isn't just a list of portraits?

positive.name: Observation
positive.evidence: You save street photography and portraits of markets.

positive.name: Voice
positive.evidence: You draft and rewrite openings until they sound like a person.

positive.name: Empathy
positive.evidence: You follow stories about elders and family trades.

positive.name: Patience
positive.evidence: You come back to long reads over several days.

persona.summary: A writer drawn to places and the people who hold them together, collecting voices before they disappear.
persona.explanation: Observation and voice come through most: you save portraits and long reads about cities and the people in them.

snapshots.name: Dev
snapshots.intent: Run an AI tutor pilot in two government school classrooms.
snapshots.problem: Teachers in government schools have fifty students and no time for one-to-one help, and most learning apps assume a phone per child.
snapshots.current_frontier: How do I measure whether students actually learned, not just used it?

positive.name: Optimism
positive.evidence: You share stories of small classroom wins and what made them work.

positive.name: Analytical
positive.evidence: You ask how outcomes were measured before you trust them.

positive.name: Teaching
positive.evidence: You explain ideas step by step when others ask.

positive.name: Persistence
positive.evidence: You stay with the same pilot questions over months.

persona.summary: An educator-builder who believes simple tools can reach every classroom, and measures before celebrating.
persona.explanation: Optimism is checked by evidence: you share hopeful stories about schools, then ask how the results were measured.

snapshots.name: Zoya
snapshots.intent: Shoot and rough-cut a fifteen-minute documentary on the last letter-writers of the old city.
snapshots.problem: The last professional letter-writers are retiring, and their trade and its stories will be lost within a few years.
snapshots.current_frontier: How do I earn the trust of people who have never been filmed?

positive.name: Observation
positive.evidence: You save frames and scenes that hold on small details.

positive.name: Patience
positive.evidence: You favour long, quiet interviews over quick cuts.

positive.name: Empathy
positive.evidence: You follow stories about people who rarely speak on camera.

positive.name: Craft
positive.evidence: You ask about lenses, light and sound in detail.

persona.summary: A filmmaker who notices what others walk past and waits for people to open up on their own time.
persona.explanation: Observation and patience lead: you save slow documentaries and long, unedited interviews.

snapshots.name: Arjun
snapshots.intent: Put every weekly market in three small towns on an open map.
snapshots.problem: Small towns are missing from the maps people use, so their markets and services are invisible.

positive.name: Structure
positive.evidence: You organise data and share clean versions.

positive.name: Generosity
positive.evidence: You publish your tools for anyone to use.

persona.summary: A systems thinker who wants every small place to be findable.
persona.explanation: Structure and generosity show up together: you build open tools and share them freely.
